subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — draft roadmap & responsibility matrix
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Reed <alyssa.reed@greenlinehealth.com>, Tom Li <tli@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — draft roadmap & responsibility matrix

Hi Alyssa / Tom — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. I captured the key points and attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a short responsibility matrix for your review ("MAP-draft-v1.pdf").

High level recap / major milestones (proposal):
- 1) Security & Compliance review (Greenline questionnaire completion + evidence delivery) — target owner: Greenline security team.
- 2) Network & Staging access (VPC peering or private endpoint) — owner: Greenline infra; Redwood to provide connection template.
- 3) Pilot integration (1-2 endpoints, sample workloads) — owner: Redwood SRE/SE (Aditya).
- 4) Quality evaluation & tuning (prompt sets + evals) — owner: Greenline product with Redwood support.
- 5) Contract & procurement sign-off — owner: Greenline procurement / legal.

Two timeline options to align against your internal windows (pick one or suggest a hybrid):
- Option A (accelerated): 6 weeks to pilot start, target close ~ Sep 18, assumes SOC2 checklist and network can be completed in parallel and Greenline can allocate a 1-week sprint for infra work.
- Option B (buffered): 10 weeks to pilot start, target close ~ Oct 16, includes 3-week security review and more conservative legal turnaround.

Major dependencies we flagged: SOC2 evidence pack, SSO/KMS decisions (if applicable), and an internal test dataset availability for prompt tuning.

Asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the preferred timeline option (A or B) and any internal blackout dates.
2) Confirm who will own each milestone on your side (names & emails) so we can lock the responsibility matrix.
3) If Option A is preferred, we should schedule a 30-minute sync next week to unblock infra items — propose Thu Aug 13 10:00am PT.

I've CC'd Aditya (SE) and Monica (CS) to weigh in on technical dependencies and onboarding steps. I attached our discovery notes as well ("discovery-notes-20260807.docx").

Thanks — happy to update the draft inline based on your feedback.

-- 
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf, discovery-notes-20260807.docx

From: Alyssa Reed <alyssa.reed@greenlinehealth.com>

Cc: 
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2026 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — draft roadmap & responsibility matrix

Thanks Sean — great summary and fast follow-up. A few quick items from our side after syncing with infra and legal: 

1) Stakeholders (please add these names to the MAP):
- Alyssa Reed (Product Lead) — alyssa.reed@greenlinehealth.com
- Tom Li (Infrastructure Lead) — tli@greenlinehealth.com
- Priya Das (Security) — priya.d@greenlinehealth.com
- Eric Monroe (Legal) — eric.monroe@greenlinehealth.com

2) Security review: our security team asked for up to 3 weeks to complete the questionnaire and evidence collection for any production-oriented data flows. I attached the filled security questionnaire for your intake (greenline-security-questionnaire.xlsx). If the questionnaire highlights additional gaps, we may need to move to Option B.

3) Network: Tom indicated he can provision a staging VPC but needs the connection template and a list of IP ranges from Redwood — Aditya if you can share that template, that would help accelerate.

4) Procurement: legal prefers there be a clear pilot acceptance criteria in the MAP. Can we add a short acceptance checklist for the pilot phase?

Preferred timeline: We would be comfortable with Option B if legal and security must be sequential. If Redwood can reduce the security evidence time (for example, by scoping the pilot to non-PHI data), we can try Option A.

I'll confirm exact availability for the Aug 13 slot by EOD. Thanks again.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Reed
Head of Product
Greenline Health
alyssa.reed@greenlinehealth.com

Attachment: greenline-security-questionnaire.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Reed <alyssa.reed@greenlinehealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — draft roadmap & responsibility matrix

On Sun, 08 Aug 2026 at 08:14 -0400, Alyssa Reed wrote:
> Tom indicated he can provision a staging VPC but needs the connection template and a list of IP ranges from Redwood — Aditya if you can share that template, that would help accelerate.

Alyssa / Tom — happy to own the connection template and provide a minimal inbound/outbound IP range set for the pilot. A couple of technical notes to avoid surprises:
- If Greenline prefers VPC peering, we'll need a short window (1-2 business days) to validate routing tables and propose a CIDR plan for test traffic.
- For a faster path we can provide a private endpoint + token-based auth to avoid peering complexity for the pilot; this generally reduces infra time by ~1 week.
- We will need a staging S3 or equivalent to hold the sample dataset; if that contains PHI, we should scope the pilot for synthetic or de-identified samples to keep security review light.

I'll upload the connection template and an option matrix to the shared Drive folder before our sync. If Greenline confirms "private endpoint" as the prefered pilot path, we can tentatively target Option A with the caveat on the 3-week security gate.

- Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Reed <alyssa.reed@greenlinehealth.com>

Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — draft roadmap & responsibility matrix

Alyssa — thanks for the quick clarity and the questionnaire. 

Action updates I made in the attached MAP draft:
- Added your stakeholder roster and contact emails.
- Inserted a 3-week security evidence task under Option B and a private-endpoint alternative under Option A.
- Added a short pilot acceptance checklist (deployable endpoint, baseline latency test, and sample inference accuracy check) for procurement/legal to sign off on.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
- Aditya to post the connection template and private-endpoint runbook to the Drive (expected by Mon Aug 9 EOD).
- Greenline to confirm preferred network option (peering vs private endpoint) and whether the pilot dataset will be synthetic/non-PHI.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute technical kickoff for Thu Aug 13 10:00am PT — sending calendar invite once Alyssa confirms.

If Greenline confirms private endpoint + synthetic data, we'll aim for Option A and set a tentative pilot start for Sep 18; otherwise we'll plan for Option B and target Oct 16.

Thanks everyone — I'll update the HubSpot deal record (HL-45329) with the MAP draft link and milestone owners.

-- 
Sean Gallagher
